audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Yone the 2+ items row while whys[6] on the same page reads "At 2+ items Kayle's ranged form and R invuln out-scale and beat you", and phases[6].why claimed "your side-lane pattern is at full power".
audit.why: Kayle's passive gives her attack speed, move speed, attack range and waves of fire as she levels — by two items she is a ranged carry Yone cannot walk at. The packet chart also has Kayle on the final row.
audit.corrected: Flipped the 2+ items row to Kayle on BOTH layers and rewrote phases[6].why to say why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was described only as "her get-out at 6" with no cooldown anywhere on the page.
audit.why: 160/120/80s is the whole reason the early game is a countdown — a 160s ultimate at rank 1 means one baited invulnerability buys you two full waves of pressure.
audit.corrected: Put 160s at rank 1 into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t, and framed the advice as bait-then-commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every trading line said "Kayle's answer is down" / "his answer is up" without naming an ability, and Kayle was called "he" or "his" in seven fields.
audit.why: The abilities that actually decide the trade are Starfire Spellblade (8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, an auto-attack reset) and Radiant Blast (12s at rank 1, 900 range, slows and shreds resistances). Naming them turns vague advice into a timer.
audit.corrected: Named both abilities with their cooldowns in tradeGood/tradeBad/breakdown.trading/breakdown.early/breakdown.mid and fixed the pronouns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of the Starfire Spellblade auto reset, and the anti-heal line in report[8] said "his healing" without naming the heal.
audit.why: Kayle's E is an auto reset, so her burst opens on an attack wind-up rather than a cast animation; Celestial Blessing is a 15s heal, which is what Grievous Wounds is being bought for.
audit.corrected: Added the wind-up tell to breakdown.early and breakdown.cooldowns, and named Celestial Blessing in the itemization line.
